title: On irreducible representations of conjugacy quandles
summary: For $G$ a finite group, one way to construct irreducible quandle representations over $\mathbb{C}$ of the conjugacy quandle $Conj(G)$ is by taking the product of an irreducible linear group representation of $G$ by what we call a quandle character of $Conj(G)$ (a quandle morphism into $\mathbb{C}^\times$ ). We show that these are all the irreducible quandle representations of $Conj(G)$ over $\mathbb{C}$ if and only if all the symmetric $2$-cocyles over $G$ ($α(g,h)=α(h,g)$ for all $g,h$) with values in $\mathbb{C}^\times$ are coboundaries.
